name: breeding-app-breeder
description: Serpentora - breeder-facing reptile management app extracted from the combined repository.

scripts.android:debug: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/android-build.ps1 -Environment development -Artifact apk -BuildType debug
scripts.android:release:apk: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/android-build.ps1 -Environment production -Artifact apk -BuildType release
scripts.android:release:aab: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/android-build.ps1 -Environment production -Artifact aab -BuildType release
scripts.android:release:all: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/android-build.ps1 -Environment production -Artifact all -BuildType release
scripts.android:install:debug: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/android-build.ps1 -Environment development -Artifact apk -BuildType debug -Install
scripts.test:e2e:reset: npm --prefix ../breeding-app-backend run e2e:reset:local && npm run test:e2e
